product_metadata.title: Bieye W10028 Victorian Tiffany Style Stained Glass Window Panel with Chain, Rectangular Shape, 18"W x 25"H
features: SIZE: 18 inches wide, 25-inches high, net weight: 6.05 lbs.
HANDMADE: This window panel was handmade of 326 hand-cutted glass sheets + 15 glass jewels. Every panel was prepared by using the copper foil method
HIGH QUALITY CHAIN: 33 inches long black hanging chain, uses electroscopic paint for flawless rust prevention.
TIMELESS COLOR: The color of Stained Glass is colorful when the sunshine passes through in the daytime, and the color of stained glass will never fade.
SAFE PACKING: Ensure safe delivery, we are not only using the foam but also using honeycomb board inside the package.
